key_features: Turn Your Microwave Into a Grill – Rocket Chef Turbo Grill Deluxe helps transform everyday microwave cooking into fast, flavorful grilling. The high-heat cooking surface heats up to 750°F to help sear, brown, and create real grill marks in minutes.

Crisy Outside, Juicy Inside - The raised ceramic nonstick grill plate helps crisp and brown foods while the vented lid helps control steam and splatter. Great for steak, burgers, chicken, fish, veggies, bacon, sausage, nuggets, and grilled cheese.

Fast Meals With Less Mess - Add your ingredients, microwave, and enjoy. Make quick breakfasts, lunches, dinners, and snacks without firing up the stove, oven, or outdoor grill. Ideal for busy weeknights, small kitchens, apartments, dorms, RVs, and office break rooms.
Ceramic Nonstick & PTFE/PFOA Free - The smooth ceramic nonstick cooking surface helps release food easily and supports simple cleanup.
Recipe Guide Included -Easy to Follow recipes for eggs, crispy bacon, wings, burgers, grilled steaks, chicken stir fry, salmon, mac and cheese, and baked potatoes, and more.
